chapter_title: Concerning the Ten Things that the Ambassador began by his Advent
chapter_note: A brief enumerative cosmological teaching: ten system-internal consequences of the Third Ambassador’s advent (builder/new aeon, ships, wheels, separations, falls, transmigrations). Apart from a formulaic speech-introduction, it contains no institutional application, exhortation, or NT citation; the dominant voice is impersonal and schematic.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic hagiographic/dialogue frame: “Once again the enlightener speaks”. This is the compiler’s container, not the substrate.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.87⟩
The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System-internal cosmological list item (office/being → cosmic construction). No audience address or institutional anchoring.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic mechanics (ships/heights/heavens) stated as process; schematic enumerative style typical of teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System description (wheels transmitting life between cosmic zones). No polemic/application shift.
List-structure continuation; content lost to lacuna but position and format match the surrounding core enumeration.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth is the doors of the ships, that they were opened up [ ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic architecture (“doors of the ships”) described in impersonal expository mode; remains within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth is the doors too [ ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Purificatory mechanism (“receive the waste”) stated as part of cosmic machine-function; no institutional referents.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is [the Sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic process involving rulers and the Ambassador; still cosmos→cosmos. “Sin” functions here as a cosmological entity/substance separated from rulers, not moral exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: The eighth: Night and day were separated [ ... ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic ordering/separation (time-cycle mechanics) in terse list form; no later citation or application.

paragraphs.core_text: The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mythic-cosmic event stated without pastoral use; remains within the cosmological narrative/mechanics register.

paragraphs.core_text: The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic/eschatological mechanism (“transmigrations… in the zone”) stated as system-function, not ethical instruction or institutional rule.
